analysis.step.resolver.hint: Matches each medicine to its generic name.

analysis.step.clinical_notes.hint: Reads age band, labs and notes, with personal details removed.

analysis.step.drug_interaction.hint: Looks up each pair of medicines in the interaction records and drug label text.

analysis.step.advisory.hint: Writes the summary from the findings only.
analysis.step.verifier.title: Verifier
analysis.step.verifier.hint: Checks every finding again against the interaction records.

analysis.error.timeout: The analysis took too long and was stopped. Please run it again.
analysis.error.pipeline_unavailable: The analysis service is not available right now. Please try again later.
